g.text: py-app-panel-tarief-evenement | type panel | trim 700 x 1000 mm, bleed 3 mm | status rebuilt
Bron: 21 printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.
Bron: TariefConcerten.pdf p1 (RGB (ICC); bleed box in bron nee). Template: trim 700 x 1000 mm, bleed 3 mm, totaal 706 x 1006 mm.

Variabelen: background-colour = #1A3580; price = €20; label = inrijdtarief; headline = Let op!; body-line-1 = Aangepast inrijdtarief; body-line-2 = op de volgende data:; day-1 = 20; month-1 = juni; day-2 = 26; month-2 = juni; day-3 = 27; month-3 = juni

700 x 1000 mm, no bleed in the source (page = trim), template adds 3 mm bleed. No hidden or off-page leftovers: all 72 source paths are on the page; the two paths that stick out (the navy field and the speech bubble) are kept in the reference. Navy field: one huge source path (956 x 1272 mm, a speech bubble of radius 527 mm centred at 350.8 /

364.4 whose pointer lies at the bottom), only the part on the page is visible. The template rebuilds the visible part as a path (source path intersected with the page plus bleed): the lower left is cut by the arc, white paper below it up to x 350.8, then a vertical edge, and a second white wedge at the bottom right where the pointer curve leaves the

page. Library: logo and tagline are py-comp-tagline-lockup at scale 2.52 (beeldmerk 73.0 mm high, library 28.95 mm), top left at 58.7 / 58.1 mm. Texts are live Ubuntu in the source and in the template: Let op! Bold 111.9 mm, two body lines Medium 55.95 mm (baselines 54 mm apart), all white; price and label are rotated 6.71 degrees counter
